title: Vegan poke bowl with sesame tofu
steps: Cook the brown rice according to the packet for about 25 minutes.
Pat the tofu dry, dice it and fry in the sesame oil in a non-stick pan for 6–8 minutes until crisp.
Mix the soy sauce, maple syrup and rice vinegar, pour half over the tofu and glaze briefly.
Boil the edamame, dice the mango, finely shred the red cabbage and slice the cucumber.
Arrange the rice, tofu and vegetables in bowls, drizzle with the remaining sauce and sprinkle with sesame.
